title: NAILS Forensics Analyzer Registry
description: Built-in analyzer and optional adapter registry for the automated forensic leak-evaluation subsystem.

analyzers.description: Compares exported stage trees against baseline and preserves only unallowlisted evidence-backed deltas.
Searches exported evidence for run-specific canary tokens with baseline-aware suppression.
Scans exported files for generic hidden-environment indicators and sensitive test markers.
Analyzes supplied bulk_extractor exports when present and cleanly skips when unavailable.
Analyzes pre-exported autopsy artifacts when provided and otherwise cleanly skips.
